entities.name: Joannes-Henricus de Franckenberg

entities.summary: Johann Heinrich, Graf von Frankenberg was Archbishop of Mechelen, Primate of the Low Countries, and a cardinal. He signed as de Franckenberg and as van Franckenberg.
